title: Contour-X

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Arai Contour-X is crafted for all-terrain explorers transitioning from tarmac to rugged single-track, bridging highway aero efficiency with rugged off-road ventilation. Built around a Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell weighing 1474g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~88 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.05 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: Designed for high-speed touring stability and comfort.

variants.title: Arai Contour-X Diamond Black
variants.description: The Arai Contour-X is a benchmark Full Face helmet crafted in Japan 🇯🇵. Built around Complex Laminate Construction (CLC) with PB-SNC2 peripheral belt reinforcement and R75 smooth shell geometry for glance-off impact energy redirection, it is engineered specifically for Intermediate Oval ergonomics. Designed for aggressive forward tuck and sport-touring postures, delivering maximum high-speed aerodynamic stability and full-coverage chin protection. Handcrafted without compromise in Japan for ultimate rider safety.

product_details.description: Designed for high-speed touring stability and comfort.

variants.introduction: Positioned in Arai's Full Face lineup, the Contour-X brings Japanese engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.05 track safety.
variants.story:
The Arai Contour-X represents Arai's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~88 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Arai Contour-X delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
variants.finish_profile: Arai Contour-X Diamond Black (gloss finish) — Treated with a mirror-finish deep gloss clearcoat that repels road grime and simplifies bug cleanup.
variants.editorial_note: Arai Contour-X in Arai Contour-X Diamond Black. A rugged dual-sport explorer built to shed dust on technical backroads while maintaining stable highway aerodynamic poise.
variants.fitment_notes: Optimized for Intermediate Oval head shapes with temple pressure-relief grooves for eyewear. 3D contoured cheek pads experience a 12-15 riding hour break-in period, relaxing by ~15% for facial fitment.

technical_analysis: Features Complex Laminate Construction (CLC) with PB-SNC2 peripheral belt reinforcement and R75 smooth shell geometry for glance-off impact energy redirection paired with VAS (Variable Axis System) shield mechanism with dual-latch shield lock and IC Duct 5 ventilation intake ports. The interior utilizes One-piece multi-density EPS liner with Eco-Pure anti-microbial removable Dry-Cool interior lining with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Arai Contour-X: combining Japan 🇯🇵 craftsmanship with VAS (Variable Axis System) shield mechanism with dual-latch shield lock and IC Duct 5 ventilation intake ports and One-piece multi-density EPS liner with Eco-Pure anti-microbial removable Dry-Cool interior lining. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Arai Contour-X: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Arai Contour-X. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.ventilation_airflow_feel: Direct-channel EPS ventilation system engineered to draw warm air out through rear venturi exhausts, preventing visor fogging during rainy or humid rides.
qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.
real_world_pros: Exceptional aero-acoustic noise damping at high speeds
Lightweight shell construction reduces neck strain on long rides
Plush, fully removable and washable antimicrobial cheek liners
real_world_cons: Snug race-contour cheek pads require 2-3 rides for break-in
Premium price point reflecting top-tier safety certifications
qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The Arai Contour-X is a benchmark Commuter Full Face helmet, engineered to deliver uncompromised safety (ECE 22.06, DOT Certified) and all-day acoustic comfort for serious riders.
qualitative_intelligence.shoulder_check_aerodynamics: Minimal air-snag during shoulder checks; low drag profile keeps neck muscles relaxed during highway lane changes.
qualitative_intelligence.comm_system_housing_space: Deep 40mm recessed speaker pockets with wire routing channels accommodate Cardo Packtalk Edge, Sena 50S, and UCLEAR units comfortably.
qualitative_intelligence.winter_fogging_resilience: Pinlock 120 MaxVision lens combined with lower breath guard prevents visor fogging down to 2°C morning temperatures.

ergonomic_features.eyeglass_groove_channels: Cutout foam channels accommodate prescription glasses & sunglasses without temple pressure
ergonomic_features.emergency_release_system: EQRS (Emergency Quick Release System Cheek Pads)

helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.forehead_pressure_point_risk: Low (Snug, even pressure distribution across forehead without hot-spots)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.glasses_temple_fit_rating: 9.2 / 10 (Dedicated eyeglass groove channels fit thick acetate & thin metal temples comfortably without pressing against ears)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.action_camera_mounting_surface: Side shell contour supports Sena / Cardo clamp mounts & 3M helmet sticky pads easily
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.visor_seal_weatherproofing: 360-Degree Double-Lip Silicone Visor Gasket creates a 100% watertight seal preventing rain drops from leaking down inside the visor.
